title: SpaceX stock gains: What its IPO signals about its future success
title_zh: SpaceX 股价上涨：其 IPO 预示着其未来的成功
summary: SpaceX stock (SPCX) continues rising in Monday's pre-market trading (maintaining gains at the session open at the time of this video's posting) ahead of the space company's first full day of trading since its historic IPO last Friday.
summary_zh: SpaceX 股票 (SPCX) 在周一盘前交易中继续上涨（在该视频发布时开盘时保持上涨），这是该太空公司自上周五历史性 IPO 以来的第一个全日交易。

title: A US-Iran deal, SpaceX IPO afterglow, Kevin Warsh's first Fed meeting: What to watch this week
title_zh: 美伊协议、SpaceX IPO 余辉、凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 首次美联储会议：本周看点
summary: Investor attention will be on Kevin Warsh's first meeting as chair of the Federal Reserve, dealmaking in the Middle East, and the second-day effects on SpaceX.
summary_zh: 投资者的注意力将集中在凯文·沃什 (Kevin Warsh) 作为美联储主席的首次会议、中东的交易以及对 SpaceX 的第二天影响上。

title: IPOs- How Much is TOO Much
title_zh: 首次公开募股——多少才算太多
summary: When I was a kid, I begged my parents to go to Golden Corral. It’s a Southern staple. Not because it has good food, but because it has ALL the food.
summary_zh: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我央求我的父母去金畜栏。这是南方的主食。不是因为它有美味的食物，而是因为它拥有所有的食物。

title: Market Minute 6-09-26- OpenAI Joins Heated IPO Race
title_zh: 市场纪要 6-09-26 - OpenAI 加入激烈的 IPO 竞赛
summary: After a mixed day on Wall Street Monday, stocks are looking to advance today. Crude oil is pulling back, while gold, silver, and Treasuries are mostly flat. The dollar is lower.
summary_zh: 周一华尔街涨跌互现，今天股市有望上涨。原油价格正在回落，而黄金、白银和国债大多持平。美元走低。

title: Anticipated SpaceX IPO ETFs: Massive Hype or Real Opportunity?
title_zh: 备受期待的 SpaceX IPO ETF：大规模炒作还是真正的机会？
summary: SpaceX IPO fever is lifting space ETFs, but history warns against chasing debut-day hype. Here's how investors can gain diversified exposure.
summary_zh: SpaceX IPO 热度正在提振太空 ETF，但历史警告不要追逐首日炒作。以下是投资者如何获得多元化投资。
